purpose: Targeted spot-check of ambiguous judgments and headline-sensitive normalization; not a random accuracy sample.
selection_method: Purposive selection of seven entity decisions and one metric-definition decision from six answers; selected after expert review. No claim of representative error rate or independence from existing public coding.
reviewer_instructions: Read the full linked answer, not only the excerpt.
Use the original codebook: C=own content cited, M=substantive explicit naming, R=active suggestion for this task.
Do not infer a product version from a parent/family label. Classify product identity, role and recommendation separately.
Record your independent decision and reason before comparing with the published assistant coding where possible. The originals are publicly accessible, so this is not a guaranteed blinded study.
Do not put private contact details in this public form. A public reviewer name is optional and requires that person’s consent.
No agreement score, human validation rate or corrected gold standard is computed until genuine human judgments exist.
